subject: Cloud Marketplace PO — finance gate crosswalk & proposed MAP
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@solacehealth.com>
Cc: Solace Health Procurement <procurement@solacehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud Marketplace PO — finance gate crosswalk & proposed MAP

Hi Bethany —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a short finance/billing crosswalk that maps how a GCP/AWS private offer would look from your procurement and invoicing perspective. High level proposal below:

- Timeline: 6-week close from SOW acceptance to invoicing activation (week 1: PO/POC acceptance; week 2: security & legal review; weeks 3–4: procurement & finance approvals; week 5: marketplace private-offer acceptance; week 6: billing activation and onboarding).
- Offer channel: AWS private offer (preferred) — can do GCP if your billing prefers.
- Billing path: Marketplace invoice to Solace Health billing entity (Solace Health, EIN 12-3456789), net 30 via marketplace invoice; we can route invoices to your AR inbox.
- Key asks: final billing entity name, PO number format, and any procurement-specific paperwork (vendor setup form, W9).

Attached: Solace_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP + milestone checklist) and brief crosswalk. Please share the primary procurement and finance contacts (name/email) who will own the PO. Once we have those, I’ll loop in legal for any redlines and share a draft DocuSign for signature.

Happy to walk through the MAP in a 30-minute call this week if helpful. Proposed times: Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 2–3pm PT.

Thanks —

Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: Solace_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page), finance_crosswalk.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@solacehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Aug 2029 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud Marketplace PO — finance gate crosswalk & proposed MAP

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick items from procurement/finance before we lock dates: 

1) Billing entity: Solace Health, Inc. (Tax ID / EIN will be shared via secure form).
2) Invoicing cadence: prefer monthly in arrears via marketplace invoice; net 45 is what our finance team typically requires — is net 45 acceptable?
3) Marketplace channel: we prefer GCP Marketplace if there are any discounts available there; second preference is AWS private offer. Can you confirm if functionality/SLAs differ between the two channels?
4) Security evidence: we require SOC 2 Type II report and an evidence package (data retention, encryption at rest/in-transit) as part of vendor onboarding.

I attached the standard procurement questionnaire — procurement will complete vendor setup once redlines and SOC2 are shared.

We can do a quick sync Thu 2pm PT.

Best,
Bethany
Director, Procurement Operations
Solace Health
Attachment: Solace_Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel form)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@solacehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Cloud Marketplace PO — finance gate crosswalk & proposed MAP

Rishi / Laura — forwarding Bethany's procurement questions so we can confirm answers and land the MAP. Summary and proposed responses below (will confirm before sending):

- Payment terms: Bethany asked for net 45. Rishi: can we accept net 45 on marketplace billing for this enterprise seat or do we need Finance approval? If marketplace requires net 30, propose we offer net 30 for first 3 months then move to net 45 for subsequent invoices (or provide a payment schedule).
- Marketplace choice: Bethany prefers GCP if discounts apply. Rishi: does Redwood have parity (features/SLAs) across AWS/GCP private offers for this account? If yes, note equivalence in reply and mention any discount/marketplace credits.
- Security: Laura: Bethany requests SOC 2 Type II and evidence package. Can Legal/Security prepare a SOC2 attestation summary and a short data handling note we can share?

Attachments: RDW_redlines_v1.pdf (I will draft minimal contract redline points and a PO acceptance template).

Next step: I’ll consolidate your inputs and send a single reply to Bethany with our answers and an updated MAP + DocuSign PO link. ETA Thu morning.

Thanks —
Grace

Attachment stubs: RDW_redlines_v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@solacehealth.com>, Solace Health Procurement <procurement@solacehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud Marketplace PO — finance gate crosswalk & proposed MAP

Hi Bethany —

Thanks for the questions — quick answers and next steps below. (See updated MAP attached.)

- Billing terms: We can accept net 45 on the marketplace invoice for Solace Health with a small payment-activation holdback clause (1 month of usage) while accounts are set up. If that sounds good to you, we’ll confirm with Finance and include language in the DocuSign PO.
- Marketplace parity: Redwood provides feature parity across AWS and GCP private offers for the capabilities you need (text generation, embeddings, private routing). There is no functional SLA difference; discounts/credits vary by cloud marketplace promotions. If you prefer GCP for commercial reasons, we’ll route the private-offer there.
- Security evidence: Laura attached a SOC2 summary and a short data handling note (encryption and retention) to the HubSpot deal record. I’ve pulled the SOC2 attestation and included the evidence pack link here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Solace/SOC2-Summary.pdf

Attachments: Solace_MAP_v2.pdf (updated MAP with an explicit week-by-week plan), RDW_redlines_v1.pdf (minimal contract redlines), DocuSign link for PO: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/ds/abc123

Proposed 6-week timeline (week numbers relative to PO acceptance):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm billing entity & PO template, agree on net 45 with activation holdback.
- Week 1: Legal redlines completed and PO routed to procurement.
- Weeks 2–3: Procurement and finance vendor setup; vendor questionnaire completion.
- Week 4: Cloud marketplace private-offer acceptance and technical onboarding scheduled.
- Week 5: Production access; final invoice routing verified.
- Week 6: Billing live and first invoice processed (monthly in arrears).

Next ask: can you confirm billing entity exactly as it should appear on the PO and provide the AR email to receive invoices? Once I have that I’ll send the DocuSign PO and request signature.

Happy to hop on the Thu 2pm PT sync if you want to walk through the updated MAP.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
